questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 영영풀이가 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
<보기>
ⓐ gate: the structure that covers or forms the top of a building, vehicle, tent etc
ⓑ award: a prize or money that is given to someone following an official decision
ⓒ clean: to remove dirt from something by rubbing or washing
ⓓ leave: to come or go back from one place to another
ⓔ present: to give something to somebody, especially formally at a ceremony
questions.explanation: ⓐ gate는 '문, 정문'으로 roof의 뜻이 아니고, ⓓ leave는 '떠나다'로 return의 뜻이 아니므로 영영풀이가 알맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 to부정사의 쓰임이 같은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?

ⓑ We didn't find a place to stay in.
ⓒ To be creative, we should try new things.
ⓓ I want a friend to talk with when I feel sad.
ⓔ He promised to hand in the report by Friday.
ⓕ They agreed not to use their phones in class.
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓓ는 모두 앞의 명사(구)를 수식하는 형용사적 용법의 to부정사입니다.

ⓕ I don't know if it will snow tomorrow.
